evidence.note: Establishes the verification loop: runs cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast, captures pass/fail counts, uses errors to drive fixes. Prescribed commands, not sporadic.
Repeatedly runs the exact verifier command (cargo test --workspace --tests --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=4) with awareness of the skip list, iterating on compile/type errors.

Drives the leaf common crate to 34/34 via repeated `cargo test -p rusternetes-common` runs and serde fixes; refuses to mark complete when workspace still failing — genuine iterate-to-green behavior but limited to one crate.
Shows awareness of hidden conformance suite and semantic needs (camelCase JSON, storage keys) but takes no verification action — no binary boot, no HTTP/JSON probe — leaving it a fixture-only loop.
No occurrence of cargo run, TcpListener/serve, curl, or serde_json semantic probes anywhere; end-to-end/runtime validation of K8s semantics is entirely absent (level-8 behavior not reached).

reasoning: The agent consistently ran the prescribed per-crate and workspace verifier commands and iterated on failures rather than assuming green-means-done, which is squarely anchor 5. It never advanced to anchor 8: despite explicit awareness of the hidden conformance suite and semantic requirements, it never booted the all-in-one binary, issued HTTP/curl checks, or wrote serde_json probes to validate JSON shape/storage-key behavior. Verification remained a fixture/test-suite loop (and only the common crate ever reached green), so the observed level is 5.
